headline: Marlee drops 159.66 on first place. Kyra's still on top, she just knows Marlee's address now.
dek: Kyra's lead is down to one game, and Cambri started Travis Kelce on his best day of the season. The Swifties in this league have been vindicated.

matchups.1-6: Kyra came in 9-1 and two games clear of everyone. Marlee beat her by 59.46, the biggest margin of the week, and the lead is down to one game. Everyone else just got a race for first back for free.
matchups.2-4: Ashton Jeanty scored 27.9 from Amie's flex (the wild-card spot), the exact number D'Andre Swift scored on her bench back in Week 8. Same points, better seat. Tara lost the closest game of the week by 6.3.
matchups.3-8: Maddie started three Carolina Panthers, Bryce Young, Chuba Hubbard and Tetairoa McMillan, as a stack (players from the same offense, so one good game pays several times), and won by 19.16. Her lineup was basically a Panthers watch party. Travis Kelce had his best game of the season for Cambri, and he gets his own section below.
matchups.5-7: Rookie Jonah Coleman scored three touchdowns and 34.9 points, the best of the week, and Maya won by 32.1. She added him off free agency in Week 9, and the cart is still paying out. Samantha had the week's low.

game_balls.title: Bad week to be in first
game_balls.text: Marlee scored 159.66, the high of the week, and left 0.7 points on her bench. Six of her starters scored 17 or more. Her bench had lint.

game_balls.title: Perfect lineup, and this one won
game_balls.text: Amie left zero points on her bench, the only manager who did. CeeDee Lamb led the way with 30.2. In Week 2 her perfect lineup lost anyway. This one won by 6.3. Perfect, now with results.

game_balls.title: Kelce gets the start
game_balls.text: In Week 2, Travis Kelce scored 25.1 on Cambri's bench. This week she started him, and he scored 25.4, more than double his 11.34 projection. Same performance, three-tenths better, and the scoreboard finally noticed.

flags.title: Emotional-support quarterback
flags.text: Dak Prescott scored 35.9 on Maddie's bench, a week after scoring 34.42 there. Bryce Young started both games and scored 15.96 this time. She won both. Dak is now her emotional-support quarterback.

flags.title: Mike Evans, reporting from the bench
flags.text: Mike Evans scored 22.9 on Maya's bench while Luther Burden III caught two passes for 10 yards in her lineup. She won by 32.1, so the only casualty is this paragraph.

tough_breaks.title: Chase vs. the weather
tough_breaks.text: Ja'Marr Chase caught five passes for 31 yards on a rainy night, the biggest miss against projection of any starter this week. A week earlier he'd scored 34.1. Samantha's 91.06 was the low of the week. Rain checks are not a fantasy stat.

tough_breaks.title: Third-best score, closest loss
tough_breaks.text: Tara scored 129.76, the third-best total of the week, and lost by 6.3. Tyler Bass, the kicker she picked up on Friday, kicked 17 points. Christian McCaffrey, fresh off last week's double shift, finished behind him.

glossary.definition: Starting a quarterback together with players from his own offense, so one big game pays you more than once, like Maddie's three Panthers this week.
The backup running back on the same NFL team as your starter, held in case the starter gets hurt, like J.K. Dobbins behind Denver's Jonah Coleman, who took 24 carries this week to Dobbins's one.

A player his team rules out of a game before kickoff, who scores zero if he's still in your lineup, which is what happened to Brock Bowers this week, after Maya had already swapped him out that morning.
A player in his first NFL season, like Jonah Coleman, who set career highs this week, which is easier when your career is a few months old.
